name: superjawn
description: Research-augmented fork of obra/superpowers. Default-on research phase at entry-point stages, narrow freshness check on stale-artifact consumers, pure consumer ports for the rest. v0.6.0 ships all 14 skills across five batches; v1.0.0 (disabling the upstream superpowers plugin) is gated on at least 2 weeks of real use.
